heading: Tonight
text: Rain spreading north, then tapering off south to north overnight. Lows in the 30s. Light southwest wind.

heading: Saturday
text: Chance of a few passing rain showers, mainly over the Greens. Highs from the low 40s north, increasing into the low 50s south. West wind 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Rain showers, mixing with snow. Tapering off south to north overnight. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. Light west wind.
